description.zh: 整理本地音乐库：体检格式、码率、缺失和乱码标签、封面与歌词，查出重复歌曲（保留音质最好的），按文件名补全标签，统一成“艺术家/专辑/音轨 - 标题”目录并生成歌单。先出方案、确认后执行、可一键撤销，永不删除文件。
description.en: Organizes local music: checks formats, bitrates, missing or garbled tags, covers, and lyrics; finds duplicates (keeping the best quality); fills tags from file names; arranges Artist/Album/Track - Title folders and builds playlists. Plan first, apply on confirmation, undo anytime — never deletes files.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我音乐放在哪个文件夹，我先帮你做个体检
welcome_message.en: Tell me where your music is — I'll start with a health check

prompt.zh: 帮我体检一下 ___ 这个文件夹里的音乐，看看有哪些问题。
prompt.en: Check the music in ___ and tell me what's wrong.

prompt.zh: 找出 ___ 里重复的歌，保留音质最好的，其余先移到一边让我确认。
prompt.en: Find duplicate songs in ___, keep the best quality, and set the rest aside for review.

prompt.zh: ___ 里很多歌没有歌手和歌名标签，文件名格式是“歌手 - 歌名”，帮我补上。
prompt.en: Many songs in ___ lack artist/title tags; file names are "Artist - Title". Fill them in.

description.zh: 艺术家/专辑/音轨 - 标题

prompt.zh: 把 ___ 里的音乐按“歌手/专辑/曲目”整理到 ___，先给我看方案。
prompt.en: Organize the music in ___ into Artist/Album/Track under ___. Show me the plan first.

prompt.zh: 按 ___（歌手/年份/流派）给 ___ 里的音乐生成歌单。
刚才的整理不满意，帮我撤销，恢复原来的位置。
prompt.en: I don't like the last reorganization. Undo it and restore the original locations.

zh: 每周日「22:00」检查下载目录新增的音乐，生成整理方案发给我确认
每月 1 日「10:00」体检整个音乐库，汇报缺标签、低码率和重复歌曲
每周一「09:00」把上周新增的歌曲按歌手更新到歌单
每天「23:00」检查下载目录有没有带乱码标签的新歌
每季度第一天「10:00」统计音乐库容量和格式分布
每月 15 日「20:00」提醒我确认 _重复文件待确认 目录里的文件
en: Every Sunday at 22:00, check new music in Downloads and send me an organizing plan
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, health-check the whole library: missing tags, low bitrates, duplicates
Every Monday at 09:00, add last week's new songs to artist playlists
Every day at 23:00, check Downloads for new songs with garbled tags
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, report library size and format mix
On the 15th of each month at 20:00, remind me to review files in the duplicates folder
